summary: Verified anniversary-cycle interest calculation for the industrial-development bank monthly-yield report. All 8 focused backend tests pass. Deposit 772500025 (1.3M @16%, created 2025-07-21) returns exactly total_interest=120811.42 for 2026 with monthly rows matching bank statement (يناير=17665.66/31d, فبراير=17665.66/31d, مارس=15956.08/28d, أبريل=17665.66/31d, مايو=17095.80/30d, يونيو=17665.66/31d, يوليو=17096.90/30d incl. +1.10 rounding adjustment). Derived daily interest = 569.86 (=round(0.16*1_300_000/365,2)). Deposit 77240000102 (1.0M @20%, created 2024-09-18 on 18th-cycle, active all of 2026) returns exactly 200000.0. previous-year endpoint 200 OK for both deposits. Trial balance 2026 is_balanced=true (debit==credit). Financial statements 2026 balance_sheet.check.total=0.0 and no critical accounting_errors. Detailed statement /statements/detailed?period_type=yearly&year=2026 returns rows containing current_year_interest.
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational, not a defect): response field `monthly_interest_amount` at the top level of the current-year report is derived from annual (amount*rate = 208000 for 772500025) and does NOT reflect the actual current-year total. The correct year total is exposed as `total_interest` (120811.42), which is what the UI should be displaying for partial-year deposits. Consider renaming or documenting to avoid consumer confusion.
